items.name: mdl77_low_crowding_model_fields
items.notes: Official 2026-05-13 field metadata shows multiple model77 Matrix fields with high/near-full coverage and alphaCount below 10. This is the cleanest new-source lane after current price-volume and EPS-family submissions.
items.next_step: Run the bounded mdl77 probe batch: field-health control, mdl77_2amv baseline/sign control, then two deep-value sibling fields.

items.name: fn_comp_options_grants_fair_value_q
items.notes: Official metadata confirms the field exists, but coverage is only 0.2391 and alphaCount is 320. User-reported Sharpe 0.42 is not enough to justify broad expansion before a sparse-field diagnostic and a sign/backfill control.
items.next_step: Hold until the mdl77 probe finishes; then test one coverage-aware backfill control and its sign flip, not a wide parameter sweep.

items.name: pv_fast_returns_vwap_composite
items.notes: User-reported Fitness 0.48 is far below the floor, and the source overlaps the active returns/vwap/volume submission family. Treat this as a control, not the next source-rotation lane.
items.next_step: Do not spend first-batch budget here. Revisit only if a structural variant can change the information source or official self-correlation evidence is favorable.

items.name: mdl77_2400_rmi_volatility_spread_reopen
items.notes: Although current metadata still shows low crowding, this exact volatility-spread lane already failed the 2026-04-25 live first batch and has a stop memo.
items.next_step: Do not reopen with cosmetic changes. Use other mdl77 fields instead.
